# OpenCV 4.12.0 notices

The application uses the unmodified official Maven Central `org.opencv:opencv:4.12.0`
Android AAR. Its archive and classes.jar do not include a standalone license bundle.
These notices are packaged as app assets to accompany the dependency.

`LICENSE` and all files from `sdk/etc/licenses/` are copied from the following
archive without content edits (repository line-ending normalization applies):

<https://github.com/opencv/opencv/releases/download/4.12.0/opencv-4.12.0-android-sdk.zip>

SDK SHA-256 verified against the official GitHub release asset digest:
`fd7f2332331b4eb8b67e55137281cfb16823c9399d90deb9cfa3476783b99e35`.

`COPYRIGHT` is copied from:
<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opencv/opencv/4.12.0/COPYRIGHT>.

The complete upstream SDK notice directory is retained; inclusion of a notice
does not establish that its corresponding optional component is linked into the AAR.
No OpenCV source or binary files are modified or vendored here.
